$Comment: Orrin's standing order, for a finished enchanter: armor and weapons unmade, and a tithe of
essence delivered. The order that pays the disenchanter's kit.
Repeat.Reset with an Every block is a SPAN cadence rather than a calendar one, which is what
three hours needs: a calendar has no three-hour boundary, so Period cannot express it. Author
Every for any window that is not Daily or Weekly, and never both in the same Reset. Widen or
narrow the Hours here to change how often the order comes round; the engine buckets anything
shorter than a day as repeatable rather than daily, so the quest list badges it that way and a
finish-so-many-dailies objective elsewhere will not count it.
It opens once The Greater Table is claimed, so it runs beside the Unmaking Rites for a player
who has finished the disenchanting chain, and the two never pay the same thing. All three
steps sit on Order 1, so they run together: unmake_armor and unmake_weapons count the two gear
classes the tables took apart ('Armor_' and 'Weapon_' on PREFIX, qualified to
'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both tiers count, each with its own TextKey), and tithe
hands Life essence in to Orrin only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'). One sitting covers all three.
The payout is two Lootable rewards, one per concern. Mmo_Enchanter_Threads is the wage and the
finds: Enchanting level and luck size the wage, and luck weighs the chance rolls at Void
essence, a draught and a Voidheart. Disenchant_Kit is the pack's own table for the four kit
pieces, the same luck-weighted rolls the Disenchanting Table itself makes, so an order filled
here is one more roll at the kit beside every ritual. Both tables roll with only the player in
context, which is why neither carries a gear condition; a station table that gates on the
placed piece can never pay from a claim, so never name one here. Both sit in the Claim bucket,
so every roll happens when the player collects.
Listing puts it in the misc category on the same shelf as the Unmaking Rites, one place after
it.
